request: Animate each selected whole pie into a slice with a visible cross section
title: Reveal pie slices on selection
purpose: Show each pie's filling and crust cross section before opening its product preview

files.purpose: Show each pie's filling and crust cross section before opening its product preview
files.previous_behavior: Shelf pies remained whole when selected; only the existing hover scale changed their appearance.
files.new_behavior: A selected pie crossfades and moves from its whole-pie layer to a transparent cutaway slice; reduced-motion preference removes the transition.
files.data_impact: None; CSS reads no operational data and changes no stored data or schema.
files.access_control_impact: None; styling has no role or permission impact.
risks: Different slice silhouettes may occupy different visual space in the shelf; desktop and mobile layouts were inspected.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to restore the single whole-pie presentation. No data rollback is needed.

files.purpose: Show each pie's filling and crust cross section before opening its product preview
files.previous_behavior: Clicking or tapping a whole pie immediately opened a preview showing the same whole-pie cutout.
files.new_behavior: Clicking or tapping reveals the matching slice on the shelf, then opens the preview after 650 ms with the slice cross section; reduced-motion users get an immediate preview. Category changes reset the revealed state.
files.data_impact: None; the component only reads existing catalog entries and newly added static image files. It performs no new writes or schema changes.
files.access_control_impact: None; selection and preview remain public and no permissions changed.
risks: A slice image could load after the transition starts on a slow connection; the eight static files and selected image loading were checked locally.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to return to immediate preview opening with whole-pie imagery. No data compatibility steps apply.

symbols: tap or click opens details and adds the chosen pie
files.purpose: Show each pie's filling and crust cross section before opening its product preview
files.previous_behavior: The interaction test checked preview opening and adding a pie but did not verify the selected slice state or preview image.
files.new_behavior: The interaction test also asserts that selection reveals the slice and that the preview uses the matching blueberry slice asset.
files.data_impact: None; this test uses browser demo state and does not touch operational data.
files.access_control_impact: None; test assertions do not change permissions.
risks: A future asset rename will require updating the preview image assertion.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to remove the additional assertions; no data rollback is needed.

production_safety.operational_data: No production operational data was read, created, updated, or deleted.
production_safety.schema_migration: None; static imagery and UI behavior only.
external_side_effects: Eight transparent slice assets were generated with the built-in image tool and copied into public/images/atelier. No deployment or external message was sent.

verification.command: pnpm exec playwright test -g "tap or click opens details|mouse drag tracks pointer" --project desktop --project mobile
verification.evidence: Three tests passed; the mouse-only test was skipped on mobile as designed.

verification.command: Playwright visual check at 1440x900 and 390x844, plus SHA-256 verification of all eight slice assets
verification.evidence: Slice motion preceded the dialog on both viewports; every generated asset matched its recorded hash.

residual_risks: The generated cross sections are illustrative and may differ from the exact appearance of pies served in store.
